name: PUC Berhad
overview: PUC Berhad 今年通过拟议收购 H BESS Sdn Bhd（代价 RM6.75 million）及已完成收购 GenieX Lab Sdn Bhd（代价 RM1.0 million）扩展业务，同时拟议出售 PUC Capital Sdn Bhd 全部股权及 Pictureworks International Holdings Limited 13.76% 股权（代价 RM30.0 million）。公司亦完成两批私人配售，合共发行约 3.048 亿股新股。
overview_en: PUC Berhad expanded its business this year through the proposed acquisition of H BESS Sdn Bhd (consideration RM6.75 million) and the completed acquisition of GenieX Lab Sdn Bhd (consideration RM1.0 million), while proposing to dispose of its entire equity interest in PUC Capital Sdn Bhd and a 13.76% equity interest in Pictureworks International Holdings Limited (consideration RM30.0 million).

segments.name: 电子支付方案
segments.note: 今年通过子公司 G Universe 收购 GenieX Lab 全部股权，并拟出售 PUC Capital 全部股权。
segments.note_en: This year, the group acquired the entire equity interest in GenieX Lab through subsidiary G Universe, and proposed to dispose of its entire equity interest in PUC Capital.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方于 2026 年 9 月 4 日签订变更契约，修改 2026 年 6 月 4 日条款清单中有关拟出售 PUC Capital 的若干条款。
actions.text_en: The parties entered into a deed of variation on 4 September 2026 to vary certain terms of the binding term sheet dated 4 June 2026 in respect of the proposed disposal of PUC Capital.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 6 月 4 日与 Tham Lih Chung 签订具约束力条款清单，拟出售全资子公司 PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd. 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a binding term sheet with Tham Lih Chung on 4 June 2026 for the proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 G Universe Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 5 月 20 日与 Robinhood Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 签订股份出售协议，以 RM1,000,000 现金收购 GenieX Lab Sdn. Bhd. 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary G Universe Sdn. Bhd. entered into a share sale agreement with Robinhood Ventures Sdn. Bhd. on 20 May 2026 to acquire 100% equity interest in GenieX Lab Sdn. Bhd. for a cash consideration of RM1,000,000.

segments.name: 其他业务
segments.note: 今年拟收购 H BESS Sdn Bhd 全部股权，并拟出售 Pictureworks International Holdings Limited 13.76% 股权。
segments.note_en: This year, the group proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in H BESS Sdn Bhd and proposed to dispose of a 13.76% equity interest in Pictureworks International Holdings Limited.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: H BESS 收购的股份出售协议先决条件已于 2026 年 10 月 13 日全部达成，拟议收购被视为完成。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent under the share sale agreement for the H BESS acquisition were fulfilled on 13 October 2026, and the proposed acquisition is deemed completed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 6 月 18 日宣布拟以 RM6.75 million 现金收购 H BESS Sdn Bhd 全部股权。
actions.text_en: The company announced on 18 June 2026 a proposed acquisition of the entire equity interest in H BESS Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM6.75 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司于 2025 年 12 月 31 日与 MacOS Limited 签订股份出售协议，拟以 RM30,000,000 现金出售 Pictureworks International Holdings Limited 13.76% 股权（3,038,040 股）。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a share sale agreement with MacOS Limited on 31 December 2025 to dispose of 3,038,040 shares representing 13.76% equity interest in Pictureworks International Holdings Limited for a cash consideration of RM30,000,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成两批私人配售，合共发行约 3.048 亿股新股。
segments.note_en: This year, the company completed a two-tranche private placement, issuing approximately 304.8 million new shares in total.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 第二批 127,022,301 股配售股于 2026 年 11 月 11 日在 ACE Market 上市，私人配售随之完成。
actions.text_en: The second tranche of 127,022,301 placement shares was listed on the ACE Market on 11 November 2026, completing the private placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 董事会于 2026 年 11 月 3 日将第二批 127,022,301 股配售股的发行价定为每股 RM0.045。
actions.text_en: The board fixed the issue price for the second tranche of 127,022,301 placement shares at RM0.045 per share on 3 November 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 董事会于 2026 年 10 月 2 日将第一批 177,777,699 股配售股的发行价定为每股 RM0.045。
actions.text_en: The board fixed the issue price for the first tranche of 177,777,699 placement shares at RM0.045 per share on 2 October 2026.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 公司拟以 RM6.75 million 现金收购 H BESS Sdn Bhd 全部股权，进入此前没有的电池储能业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in H BESS Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM6.75 million, entering the battery energy storage business which it did not previously have.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售全资子公司 PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd. 100% 股权，退出该业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of its entire 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd., exiting the business.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟以 RM30,000,000 现金出售 Pictureworks International Holdings Limited 13.76% 股权。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of a 13.76% equity interest in Pictureworks International Holdings Limited for a cash consideration of RM30,000,000.
